acceptance_criteria: Backend selects L1/L2/L3 from stored skill evidence; word count and prerequisites enforced deterministically
notes: LLM cannot alter level or declare skill mastery

acceptance_criteria: Backend selects a mode from explicit intent and context; explicit stop/play overrides lesson continuation
Supportive responses follow policy and are not diagnostic; sentiment cues are treated as ephemeral conversational context
notes: Educational companion only; no diagnostic or clinical labeling

acceptance_criteria: Only relevant child-scoped context is supplied to the LLM; capped at 800 tokens and 5 recent turns
Progress persists across sessions in PostgreSQL; functions reliably without Redis dependency
notes: PostgreSQL is single authoritative source of truth

acceptance_criteria: Cross-child access is denied and deletion/retention are tested; PII collection strictly prohibited
notes: Hard deletion within 72 hours; logs redacted

acceptance_criteria: Invalid or unsafe model output is rejected or replaced safely; complete response validated before display
notes: Enforces word limits and content filters; deterministic safe fallback

acceptance_criteria: P95 end-to-end completion latency is below 2000 ms for defined normal load; fallbacks reported separately
notes: Complete validated response delivery under 10 concurrent VUs

acceptance_criteria: Child can chat and see persisted progress; parent dashboard renders committed backend metrics
notes: Accessible child UI and parent progress dashboard

acceptance_criteria: Backup restore and rollback are evidenced; migrations are reversible and tested
notes: Disaster recovery runbook and Alembic migration verification

acceptance_criteria: Explicit adult verification and consent required before child chat sessions are permitted
notes: Consent workflow flagged for jurisdictional legal review

acceptance_criteria: Inactivity timeout of 15 minutes and turn idempotency prevent session abuse and duplicate scoring
notes: Token bucket rate limiting and client idempotency keys
